settings.title: Settings
settings.noOptionsDescription: Options will appear here when the related feature can be configured.
settings.autoLoadRemoteImagesDescription: Remote images may tell senders when and where a message was opened. This preference applies to every message on this device.
settings.autoLoadMoreMessages: Load more messages at the end of the list
settings.autoLoadMoreMessagesDescription: When enabled, the next page loads automatically near the bottom of the message list. Turn it off to use the Load more button instead.
settings.autoLoadMoreContacts: Load more contacts at the end of the list
settings.autoLoadMoreContactsDescription: When enabled, the next page loads automatically near the bottom of the contact list. Turn it off to use the Load more contacts button instead.
settings.minimizeToTray: Minimize to tray when closing the main window
settings.minimizeToTrayDescription: When exit confirmation is disabled, this setting decides whether closing the main window hides it in the tray or exits the app.
settings.askBeforeExitDescription: Ask whether to minimize to the tray or quit when closing the main window. Choosing Don't ask again disables this option and remembers that choice.
settings.autoCheckUpdates: Automatically check for updates at startup
settings.autoCheckUpdatesDescription: NextMail checks for a new version in the background after startup. Installation still requires your confirmation.

categoryDescription.general: Choose the interface language and general behavior.
categoryDescription.appearance: Adjust the interface mode and theme color.
categoryDescription.accounts: Add, switch, and manage account connections and synchronization.
categoryDescription.composer: Manage default composing and editor preferences.
categoryDescription.advanced: Manage list loading, storage, connection, and other runtime options.
categoryDescription.about: View the NextMail version and product information.

settings.launchAtStartupDescription: Start NextMail automatically when you sign in. The main window stays hidden in the tray until you open it.

desktop.closeDescription: Would you like to minimize the main window to the tray or quit NextMail?
desktop.rememberCloseChoice: Don't ask again and remember this choice

updates.availableDescription: NextMail will restart and install the update after the download completes.
updates.noReleaseNotes: No additional notes were provided for this release.

notifications.enabledDescription: Show notifications for newly synchronized unread messages. Initial synchronization and cache rebuilds stay silent.
notifications.accountsDescription: Each account can be disabled independently. Inbox notifications are enabled by default; other folders are opt-in.
notifications.folderDescription: Choose which folders may produce new mail notifications for this account.

about.title: About NextMail
about.description: A focused, secure desktop mail client designed for offline use.
